profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at WellHive
profile.summary: Experienced Information Technology professional with a talent for learning and mastering new technology. Proficient in a wide range of operating systems, tools, programs, and applications. Successful in both team-based and self-directed environments.

positions.title: JLV System Engineer - Sustainment Team
positions.description:
•Defense Health Agency (DoD) and VA healthcare application support and customer service
•Quickly diagnose technical issues and provide resolutions during assigned hours. Log and provide timely application support to all tickets, and application users using Remedy and ServiceNow following HIPAA guidelines
•Knowledge of network technologies, DoD and VA healthcare systems, healthcare applications, and web-based services enabling the secure viewing of healthcare data
•Analysis and monitoring of system metrics via AppDynamics and SPLUNK systems
•Write SQL queries to update databases, Windows 2008/2012 Server Administration, VM administration via VMWare vCenter, Log assessment, Systems monitoring and cleanup, Software update deployments, SOAP UI Testing. CAC and PIV usage
•Deployments via Amazon AWS, Ansible, Nexus and Jenkins
•Initial point of contact for DoD and VA healthcare providers and users needing access and support for a web-based electronic health record viewer hosted on Government networks
•Communicate and work alongside other DoD support teams (AHLTA/CDR, AVHE Citrix, DES, DMDC/PDWS, DoD NSOC, DMIX, HAIMS, MHS Genesis, TMDS) VA support teams (MVI, SSOi, VA NSOC, VAAFI Datapower, VistA Systems)

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description:
• Set up new user accounts to all company systems, new workstations, and desks.
• Responsible for keeping tech inventory at optimum levels to meet user needs and submitting orders for low stock.
• Provide daily technical support in a Windows environment.
• Administer Office 365 accounts and exchange using Azure Active Directory.
• RingCentral (VoIP) Administrator. 
• Document all  technical processes and procedures. 
• Managed recycling project to clean out old unused tech

positions.title: OnBase System Administrator (IT Analyst)
positions.description:
• Built a solution for the University of Florida HR department that streamlines the Higher Education Opportunity Scholarship Program. It allows the entire process to be electronically managed using a database and forms. It greatly reduced the amount of time spent by the coordinator working on the scholarship by using automation. 
• Identify departmental documentation processes, needs, and requirements.
• Build and design electronic document management systems to meet customer usage and cost requirements using electronic forms and workflow. 
• Manage assigned projects, set milestones,  testing schedules, and go-live dates, while communicating progress to customers.
• Build Document Types, Keywords, Unity Forms, and workflows.
• Certified Onbase Administrator.

positions.title: IT Resident
positions.description:
• Provide internal Google support for Linux, OS X, Windows, Chrome OS and Android platforms in addition to network-based applications.
• Managed a project with the Google Advocacy Team. This project involved gathering data, planning, and rewriting an internal teams' set of troubleshooting documents.
• Diagnose complex infrastructure, account, networking, mobile, and operating system issues
• Troubleshoot Google’s corporate resources, network, and applications.
• Mentor and guide new team members with questions on procedures and issues they encounter.
• Provide support for services such as video conferencing, remote access, new internal products, and mobile technology.
• Provide support across all support channels, including chat, email, phone, video, and in-person.
• Analyze incoming requests and create self-service documentation for Google’s internal users and the global support team.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
• Researched, purchased, and implemented new desktops and laptops.
• Assisted with migrating from AppRiver to Microsoft Office 365 exchange services.
• Maintain and fix workstations, VoIP phones, and Windows servers. 
• Wrote user documentation and documented technical processes.

positions.title: Help Desk Support Specialist II
positions.description:
• Received client queries from Florida Virtual High School teachers, parents, and students regarding system problems by phone, email and ticket.
• Logged and tracked incidents and service requests using Service Now.
• Worked an assigned shift in a fast paced, 7/24/365 IT Service Desk environment. 
• Used Windows Active Directory to configure accounts and reset passwords.
• Remotely accessed and troubleshot computers using Bomgar.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
• Used Dell Kace System to manage computer images and install Windows.
• Configure and troubleshoot computers and printers. 
• Helped get teacher laptops ready for the new year by freeing up space, installing updates, and new software.
